description: The market in numbers: open roles and firms hiring, how many roles are new in the last `days` (default 7) versus the window before, the firms posting the most, the firms whose posting is rising, and the new roles by role type, level, country and city. Narrow it with `city`, `country` (ISO2 or name), `category`, `level` or `kind`. For the signed-in member it also names followed firms that posted nothing new. Use it for "who is hiring in London this week", "which banks are ramping up", "how busy is the summer internship season".

category.description: Role type, one of: Trading, Research, Investment Banking, Mergers & Acquisitions, Private Equity, Venture Capital, Asset Management, Strategy Consulting, Technology, Business & Operations, General

city.description: A city page slug or name, e.g. london, newyork, amsterdam (see list_cities)

country.description: ISO2 code or country name, e.g. NL, GB, "United Kingdom"

kind.description: Kind of firm slug, e.g. hedge-funds, investment-banks, proprietary-trading-firms (see list_companies)

level.description: Level, one of: Summer Internship, Off-Cycle Internship, Working Student, Graduate Program, Entry Level

name: market_stats
title: Who is hiring
